watch.summary: The creator reacts with intense excitement and hype as he watches a pro Valorant player make an incredible play during an esports replay.

beats.what: The creator screams with his hands on his head in shock at the play setup.
The replay shows the pro player jumping over a wall and locking onto enemies.
The pro player lands impressive consecutive shots to win the round.
The creator yells 'Get him out of here!' and walks away from his chair in disbelief.
The creator returns to his desk, smiles, and chuckles 'Not bad'.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: This clip is driven by high-energy esports hype and skillful gaming rather than comedy. The humor comes mainly from the creator's exaggerated shock and walking off camera.
